# CI-only Python tooling, pinned here rather than inline in a workflow's `run:`
# line so the pin has an automated bumper: Dependabot's `pip` ecosystem reads this
# file (see .github/dependabot.yml), while nothing parses a version written inside
# a `run:` block — Renovate's custom.regex manager can, Dependabot has no
# equivalent. An unbumpable pin rots into the same stale-tooling problem from the
# other direction.
